items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Jones, piano, Harold Jones, drums, and Jim Hewitt, bass. Just quartet.

ctx.x: Yeah, I did a concert this past Sunday and in my group I had Jimmy Jones, piano, Harold Jones, drums, and Jim Hewitt, bass. Just quartet. And it was quite nice, I enjoyed it very much. But my daughter was there, you know.
So she knows that I exist. As a musician. [PAUSE]
